adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts the reference object built for non-calendar integrations now sets `credentialId` to `undefined` (`credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined`). Previously, the non-calendar branch stored `result.credentialId`, so this diff clearly removes credentialId persistence for video integrations (Zoom/Daily/etc.). If later cleanup/deletion logic relies on stored `credentialId` to select the correct integration credential, those references will no longer have it, which can lead to orphaned video meetings.
